title: Deterministic level-up application engine (core)
description: Core engine that applies a single level-up deterministically from rules-pack data, operating on the authoritative character record decided in .13 (persisted/finalized/current character — not the legacy creation draft). It must reuse and generalize the existing deterministic derivation seams rather than reinventing math in the CLI: deriveLevel1Values is explicitly level-1 only, so generalize it (or add a parallel module sharing a common core) so that proficiency bonus, HP increase (hit die + CON per rules-pack/recipe policy), saving throws, spell DC/attack, class-feature grants (by ref), and spellcasting progression all derive from the rules-pack/resolver layer. Builds on the generalized resolver (.3) and progression state (.2). Produces a canonical, auditable change set applied via mutation; invents nothing not in the pack.
acceptance_criteria: Engine takes a character + target level and returns/applies a deterministic change set (HP, level, prof bonus, features, spellcasting); applied via auditable mutation; tests assert exact deltas for martial and caster classes.
notes: Review fix pushed (edeca25): added fail-closed detectLevelUpRequiredChoices + LevelUpRequiredChoicesError; applyLevelUp blocks subclass/ASI/fighting-style/expertise/spell-learning levels writing nothing. Deterministic rows still apply. Audit-field validation hardening. 11 tests. PR #340 updated.
